# Adir Ben David (אדיר בן דוד · adirbd)

> DevOps engineer by profession, systems thinker by nature. Based in Tel Aviv. Over a decade of hands-on infrastructure experience spanning physical Layer 2/3 networks, firewalls, and leading an on-prem systems/virtualization team to cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, GitOps, and observability at Check Point Software Technologies.

Adir Ben David is a DevOps engineer at Check Point Software Technologies in Tel Aviv. He designs and operates cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure as code with Terraform, Terragrunt, and Crossplane, running Kubernetes clusters across staging and production with Karpenter, Helm, Argo CD, and self-hosted GitHub Actions runners (ARC). He builds CI/CD pipelines, artifact flows (JFrog), and secret/identity management as code with AWS Secrets Manager, IAM, and OIDC, maintains observability with Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, and OpenTelemetry, participates in production on-call and zero-downtime operations (including RDS blue/green upgrades), uses AI agents with plan-and-review workflows to accelerate infrastructure changes and diagnostics, and operates and maintains infrastructure in a FedRAMP-compliant environment in partnership with R&D and Security. He joined Check Point in December 2019; before DevOps he led a six-person team that built and operated complex on-prem environments (servers, networking, firewalls, and ESXi virtualization) from 2021 to 2024. Earlier he was a Tier-2 networking engineer at Bezeq (2017-2019) working with multi-vendor Layer 2/3 networks, routers, and switches, and a communications network technician in the Communications and Computers Corps (Tikshuv) during military service (2014-2017). Having worked in both on-prem data centers and the cloud shapes how he approaches systems.

Career timeline:
- **DevOps Engineer · Check Point Software Technologies** (Oct 2024 – Present · Tel Aviv): Cloud infrastructure on AWS (primary) and Azure as code using Terraform, Terragrunt, and Crossplane; Kubernetes cluster operations across staging and production with Karpenter, Helm, Argo CD, and self-hosted GitHub Actions runners (ARC); CI/CD pipelines, artifact flows (JFrog), and secret/identity management as code (AWS Secrets Manager, least-privilege IAM, OIDC); observability with Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, and OpenTelemetry; production on-call, incident response, and zero-downtime operations (such as RDS blue/green upgrades); AI-agent-assisted infrastructure changes and diagnostics with plan-and-review workflows; operating and maintaining infrastructure in a FedRAMP-compliant environment.
- **COST Team Leader · Check Point Software Technologies** (Jul 2021 – Oct 2024 · Tel Aviv): Led a 6-person infrastructure and integration team operating 100+ servers, routers, switches, ESXi hosts, and firewalls in complex customer-like production validation environments.
- **COST QA Engineer · Check Point Software Technologies** (Dec 2019 – Jul 2021 · Tel Aviv): Built physical and virtual enterprise environments end to end (servers, ESXi, networking, security stacks) and developed automation with Python, Jenkins, and Docker.
- **Networking Engineer, Tier 2 (Strategic Business) · Bezeq** (May 2017 – Dec 2019): Configured and troubleshot multi-vendor Layer 2/3 networks (Cisco, Juniper, Check Point, Fortigate, Aruba) for telecom, finance, defense, and enterprise customers.
- **Communication Network Technician · IDF (Tikshuv)** (Jan 2014 – Jan 2017): Managed operational Layer 2/3 networks and field troubleshooting.

Technical skills and domains: DevOps, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Karpenter, K3s, Terraform, Terragrunt, OpenTofu, Crossplane, Argo CD, GitOps, Helm, Docker, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Actions Runner Controller (ARC), JFrog Artifactory, AWS Secrets Manager, OIDC, IAM, Amazon RDS, Infrastructure as Code, Linux, Bash, Python, observability, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry, FedRAMP compliance, AI agents, Cloudflare, Tailscale, WireGuard, Proxmox, ZFS, on-prem infrastructure, systems integration, virtualization (ESXi), firewalls, networking (Layer 2/3).

Certifications: Check Point Certified Security Expert (CCSE), Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA), Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Routing and Switching, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) Routing and Switching, Cisco Certified Entry Networking Technician (CCENT).

Contact email: adirbd@me.com

## Travel Albums

- [Japan (2026)](https://www.adirbd.com/trips/japan.html): A long rail loop through Osaka, Nara, Kyoto, and Tokyo, out to the lakes under Mount Fuji, then a Rome finale before the flight home.
- [Avoriaz (2026)](https://www.adirbd.com/trips/avoriaz.html): A week on the snow: chairlifts, long runs, and mountain light from first lift to last.
- [The Matterhorn (2025)](https://www.adirbd.com/trips/matterhorn.html): Riding both sides of the border, Zermatt in Switzerland and Cervinia in Italy, under one of the most recognizable peaks in the Alps.
- [Thailand (2024)](https://www.adirbd.com/trips/thailand.html): The green, misty north around Chiang Mai and Pai, then the southern islands, ending in Bangkok. A warm, easy pace the whole way.
